ModMetaData.name: [MLP] My Little RimPony - Medieval Overhaul Patches
ModMetaData.author: GeodesicDragon
ModMetaData.description: About This mod contains a series of patches which will make My Little RimPony (MLRP) more compatible with Medieval Overhaul. Many buildings which use electricity have been turned into glorified art pieces, other buildings have been patched to require materials added by Medieval Overhaul in their construction, and recipes at Daybreaker now use coal instead of chemfuel. Granny Smith is a new building; she acts like a sunlamp, but doesn't require any electricity. "Why are these patches separate from the main mod?" Because I'd rather let people decide for themselves whether or not they want to use them. "Hey, something broke!" Let me know via Discord (GeodesicDragon) or the My Little RimPony Steam Group (Advanced --> Website).
